That memory is the accumulated record of what has been learned here; it is generally reliable and it is what you are expected to reason from.

  Analyst time is limited. You may pull the archived source record for at most

    simplify_onboarding · promotional_pricing · referral_incentive ·
    activation_messaging · enterprise_sales_assist

action you currently intend. Answer with the structured object only.

Promotional pricing (memory_73) is tempting given the competitor's entry-pricing move, but reacting in kind risks a race-to-bottom that could erode qualified revenue by attracting price-sensitive, lower-LTV accounts rather than addressing the underlying activation/onboarding decline—so I want to re-check its original record for caveats about segment durability before ever considering it. I also want to verify memory_86 directly since it's the most recent and most specific match to the current onboarding metric, to confirm the original experiment's scope and whether the lift held across segments before committing this week's single experiment slot to it.
